Is Higgsfield worth it?

Higgsfield plan rates we track run from $0.033/s (Ultra annual, 480p) to $0.492/s (Plus monthly, Veo 3.1 720p, approximate). Both assume every credit you pay for is used. The table sets each plan rate next to the cheapest non-Higgsfield rate for that model.

Is Higgsfield Pro's 1,000 credits enough for Seedance, or should I use Kling instead?

Higgsfield Pro's price and a 1,000-credit allowance are not in our plan data, so the figures below are per 1,000 credits on the plans we do track. At the Kling 3.0 720p credit rate we track (7.5 credits for a 5-second clip, an approximate rate), 1,000 credits is about 133.33 clips, or 666.67 seconds. Seedance 2.5 has no Higgsfield credits-per-clip row, so there is no Seedance second count from 1,000 credits. Left out: Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 per-clip credits (Plan page only says '~80 Seedance 2.5 videos' for 1,200 credits without clip length/resolution). Left out: Higgsfield Kling 3.0 credits (Compare table says ~7 credits/5s at 720p, plan quiz says ≈14 credits per 8s 720p; both approximate). The cheapest Kling 3.0 rate outside Higgsfield is $0.0594 per second on Magnific (plan tier Pro (annual), resolution 1080p, audio not listed), a vendor-stated rate (checked 2026-10-31). Assumes every credit you pay for is used. The cheapest Seedance 2.5 rate outside Higgsfield is $0.132 per second on Magnific (plan tier Pro (annual), resolution 480p, audio not listed), a vendor-stated rate (checked 2026-10-31). Assumes every credit you pay for is used. Clip and second counts are 1,000 divided by credits per clip, rounded half up to 2 decimal places. The two rates are the comparison.

Which models have no Higgsfield plan price?

No Higgsfield plan or API row for Gemini Omni Flash 1.1, Runway Gen-4.x, Grok Imagine Video 1.5. A Higgsfield API row and no Higgsfield plan row for Seedance 2.5. Starter: no row for Veo 3.1. Left out: Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 per-clip credits (Plan page only says '~80 Seedance 2.5 videos' for 1,200 credits without clip length/resolution). Left out: Higgsfield Kling 3.0 credits (Compare table says ~7 credits/5s at 720p, plan quiz says ≈14 credits per 8s 720p; both approximate).

How do we calculate this?

Every dollar figure on this page comes from the price rows when the site is built. API rows use the vendor's stated dollars per second. Credit-plan rows use plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and assumes every credit you pay for is used. A promo shows its end date. An approximate row is one the vendor marked with "~", "roughly", or "estimated". The full method is on the about page (https://sheepinboots.github.io/clipcost/about/).
